# Sean Taylor

> Sean Taylor is an executive producer, product architect and fractional CPO based in Dubai, originally from Scotland. He makes games and playful things, and helps founders and studios with product direction, prototyping, production and the route to market.

Sean has 30 years of experience and has shipped 100+ games. Selected work includes the original Grand Theft Auto at DMA Design, producing the BAFTA-winning Quarrel at Denki, establishing and leading InGAME at Abertay University, and serving as Chief Product Officer at Battlepass Labs. He co-wrote Punk Playthings with Chris Lowthorpe.

He is currently product lead on an unannounced game alongside fractional product and advisory work. He is interested in fractional engagements and permanent Head of Product or Executive Producer roles. The homepage and Experience page provide his current positioning and career details; the separate notebook contains his ongoing writing.

## Profile and experience

- [Home](https://seantaylor.work/): Current work, selected projects, writing and contact routes.
- [Experience](https://seantaylor.work/experience.html): Working approach, selected roles, writing, speaking, awards and professional affiliations.
- [Battlepass Labs](https://seantaylor.work/experience.html#battlepass): Product strategy, customer discovery and prototyping, 2024-2026.
- [InGAME](https://seantaylor.work/experience.html#ingame): Leadership of a publicly funded games research and innovation centre, 2018-2024; programme outcomes and a linked independent assessment of projected economic impact.
- [Denki and Quarrel](https://seantaylor.work/experience.html#denki): Production and product architecture across mobile, interactive TV, browser and console, 2006-2015.

## Writing

- [Notebook](https://notes.seantaylor.work/): Current writing and the public archive on games, playful media, audiences, product strategy, culture, AI and attention. Hosted separately from this site.
- [Punk Playthings](https://www.routledge.com/Punk-Playthings-Provocations-for-21st-Century-Game-Makers/Taylor-Lowthorpe/p/book/9781498770224): Book co-written with Chris Lowthorpe, published by CRC Press in 2017.
- [Punk Provocations](https://seantaylor.work/punk-provocations/): The 2026 remix of Punk Playthings.
- [Post-Industrial Playful Media](https://seantaylor.work/post-industrial-playful-media.html): Theses in progress about distribution, attention and participatory playthings.
- [Notes index](https://seantaylor.work/notes-index.html): Discovery index linking to canonical articles in the notebook; consult the notebook for the latest posts.
- [Notes index JSON](https://seantaylor.work/notes-index.json): Machine-readable companion to the notes index, with titles, URLs, dates, summaries and topics.
